source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_TRU_ACCOUNT WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
[BR_CD]
,[SUB_BR_CD]
,STG.[BASE_NO]
,[LAST6_BASE_NO]
,[CUST_NO]
,STG.[PORTFOLIO_NO]
,[LAST6_PORTFOLIO_NO]
,STG.[ACC_NO]
,[LAST6_ACC_NO]
,[ACC_TYPE]
,[ACC_NAME]
,[ACC_CCY]
,[ACC_STATUS]
,[RISK_PROFILE]
,convert(date,[LAST_REVIEW_DATE]) as LAST_REVIEW_DATE
,[CITY]
,[ZIP_CODE]
,STG.[STATUS]
,[MAKER_ID]
,convert(date,[MAKER_DATE]) as MAKER_DATE
,[AUTH_ID]
,convert(date,[AUTH_DATE]) as AUTH_DATE
,[REMARKS]
,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([BALANCE],' ',''),''),0)) as BALANCE
,[INTER_COMP_ACCT]
,[ACCT_CREATION_TYPE]
,[LEGAL_ENTITY]
,[LEGACY_ACC_NO]
,[SOURCE_TYPE]
,[SOURCE_DESC]
,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([VERSION],' ',''),''),0)) as VERSION
,[HELD_WITH_BANK]
,[HOLDING_STATEMENT]
,[ACCT_SUB_TYPE]
,convert(date,[ACCT_OPEN_DT]) as ACCT_OPEN_DT
,[RM_ID]
,[TAXABLE]
,[DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION]
,[DISPOSITION_ACCT]
,[BANK_NAME]
,[PREFERRED_FLAG]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[TRU_ACCOUNT_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [D360].[STG_TRU_ACCOUNT] STG ON DELTA.ACC_NO = STG.ACC_NO AND DELTA.PORTFOLIO_NO = STG.PORTFOLIO_NO AND DELTA.BASE_NO = STG.BASE_NO 
 where H = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_TRU_PORTFOLIO WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
[BR_CD]
,[SUB_BR_CD]
,STG.[BASE_NO]
,[LAST6_BASE_NO]
,STG.[ACC_NO]
,[LAST6_ACC_NO]
,STG.[PORTFOLIO_NO]
,[LAST6_PORTFOLIO_NO]
,[PORTFOLIO_NAME]
,[MAKER_ID]
,convert(date,[MAKER_DATE]) as MAKER_DATE
,[AUTH_ID]
,convert(date,[AUTH_DATE]) as AUTH_DATE
,STG.[STATUS]
,[REMARKS]
,[DEFAULT_PORTFOLIO]
,[PORTFOLIO_TYPE]
,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([VERSION],' ',''),''),0)) as VERSION
,[PORTFOLIO_CATEGORY]
,[MODEL_PORTFOLIO]
,[RM_ID]
,[PROD_CODE]
,[PF_DESCRIPTION]
,[SUBSCRIPTION_ID]
,[GARNISHMENT]
,convert(numeric(35,15),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([GARNISHMENT_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) as GARNISHMENT_AMT
,convert(date,[REVIEW_DATE]) as REVIEW_DATE
,[RISK_PROFILE]
,convert(numeric(6,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([EXT_PORTFOLIO_NO],' ',''),''),0)) as EXT_PORTFOLIO_NO
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[TRU_PORTFOLIO_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [D360].[STG_TRU_PORTFOLIO] STG ON DELTA.BASE_NO = STG.BASE_NO AND DELTA.PORTFOLIO_NO = STG.PORTFOLIO_NO  AND DELTA.ACC_NO = STG.ACC_NO 
 where H = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_TRU_FXRATES WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT
[BR_CD]
,STG.[SOURCE_CCY_CODE]
,[TARGET_CCY_CODE]
,convert(numeric(34,14),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([BUYING_RATE],' ',''),''),0)) as BUYING_RATE
,convert(numeric(34,14),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([SELLING_RATE],' ',''),''),0)) as SELLING_RATE
,convert(numeric(34,14),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([BOOK_RATE],' ',''),''),0)) as BOOK_RATE
,convert(date,STG.[EFFECTIVE_DATE]) as EFFECTIVE_DATE
,[MAKER_ID]
,convert(date,[MAKER_DATE]) as MAKER_DATE
,[AUTH_ID]
,convert(date,[AUTH_DATE]) as AUTH_DATE
,convert(numeric(34,14),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([SPOT_VARIANCE],' ',''),''),0)) as SPOT_VARIANCE
,[FREQUENCY]
,[REGION_CODE]
,convert(numeric(34,14),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([NORMAL_MID_RATE],' ',''),''),0)) as NORMAL_MID_RATE
,convert(numeric(34,14),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([INTER_BANK_BUY_RATE],' ',''),''),0)) as INTER_BANK_BUY_RATE
,convert(numeric(34,14),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([INTER_BANK_SELL_RATE],' ',''),''),0)) as INTER_BANK_SELL_RATE
,convert(numeric(34,14),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([INTER_BANK_MID_RATE],' ',''),''),0)) as INTER_BANK_MID_RATE
,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TREASURY_BUY_RATE],' ',''),''),0)) as TREASURY_BUY_RATE
,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TREASURY_SELL_RATE],' ',''),''),0)) as TREASURY_SELL_RATE
,convert(numeric(34,14),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TREASURY_MID_RATE],' ',''),''),0)) as TREASURY_MID_RATE
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[TRU_FXRATES_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [D360].[STG_TRU_FXRATES] STG ON DELTA.SOURCE_CCY_CODE = STG.SOURCE_CCY_CODE AND DELTA.EFFECTIVE_DATE = STG.EFFECTIVE_DATE 
 where H = 'D'

,[BASE_STATUS]

,[LAST6_CUST_NO]
,convert(numeric(3,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([NO_HLDRS],' ',''),''),0)) as NO_HLDRS

,[SIGN_COND]
,[HHLD_NO]
,[RM_ID]
,[RES_STATUS]
,[CUST_STATUS]
,[REFERENCE_CCY]
,[PHONE_FAX_INDEMINITY]
,[DOMICILE]
,[REMARKS]
,STG.[STATUS]
,[MAKER_ID]
,convert(date,[MAKER_DATE]) as MAKER_DATE
,[AUTH_ID]
,convert(date,[AUTH_DATE]) as AUTH_DATE
,[SERVICE_UNIT]
,STG.[CIF_NO]
,[CLOSURE_REMARKS]
,[REJECT_REASON]
,convert(date,[OPEN_DT]) as OPEN_DT
,convert(date,[CLOSE_DT]) as CLOSE_DT
,[FNA_ID]
,[RISK_PROFILE]
,[RISK_PROFILE_DESC]

,[FP_FLAG]
,[EXTERNAL_IDENTIFIER]
,[OTHER_CD1]

SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_TRU_AUMUITF WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
STG.BASE_NO
,LAST6_BASE_NO
,STG.PORTFOLIO_NO
,LAST6_PORTFOLIO_NO
,CUSTOMER_NAME
,CUSTOMER_TYPE
,BRANCH
,CURRENCY
,convert(numeric(22,2),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(CUSTOMER_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP,' ',''),''),0)) as [CUSTOMER_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP]
,convert(numeric(22,2),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP,' ',''),''),0)) as [TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP]
,convert(date,STG.[ASOFDATE]) as [ASOFDATE]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM  [BUSC].[TRU_AUMUITF_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_TRU_AUMUITF] STG ON DELTA.BASE_NO = STG.BASE_NO AND DELTA.PORTFOLIO_NO = STG.PORTFOLIO_NO AND DELTA.ASOFDATE = STG.ASOFDATE
where H = 'D'
